content: Yichebanil iscarta naj Santiago
Hanin Santiago intiꞌan, ischejab Comam Dios yeb Comam Jesucristo wehan. Chiwaltojan teyet cheyil heba yin̈ hecawil, hex cablahon̈eb majan wet con̈ob Israel, hex pujanexto yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ.
Huneꞌ helanile chakꞌ Comam Dios
Hex wuẍtaj, hex wanab, hayet chihul sunil ilwebal teyiban̈, caw akꞌwe tzalaho hecꞌul sicꞌlebil.
Heyohtaj ta hayet chul ilwebal teyiban̈ yu yillaxi ta ayco Comam Dios yipo heyanma, hac tuꞌ chu hecuyni istecha ilwebal heyu.

Yilal helahnico heyakꞌni heyanma istecha heyu, hac tuꞌ chu hechꞌib yin̈ yet Comam Dios, yeb xin tzꞌajan chexelcanico yin̈ iscꞌulal Comam, hac tuꞌ xin matxa nichꞌano tzet mach tzꞌajanojex yin̈ yet Comam.

Tato ay hunujex maẍto tzꞌajano hehelanil, kꞌanwe tet Comam Dios, cat yakꞌni Comam teyet, yuto mach chismale Comam yakꞌni tet macta chikꞌanni. Chakꞌ Comam tet, yaj mach chalico Comam yin̈ sat mac bay chakꞌ Comam huneꞌ tuꞌ.
Hayet chicokꞌanni cohelanil tet Comam, cokꞌanawe yin̈ sunil janma. Machojab chicabcon janma, yuto haꞌ mac chicabcon yanma, lahan hacaꞌ haꞌ mar chꞌecꞌ jobla yu jakꞌekꞌ; nanantaxan̈e bay chitocanicoj.
Haꞌ mac hac tuꞌ yecoj, tajca chꞌecꞌ yin̈ isnabal ta ay tzet chischah tet Comam Dios Jahawil.
Yuto nan chꞌecꞌ yin̈ isnabal tinan̈, nanxapaxo chꞌecꞌ yin̈ isnabal hecal, hac tuꞌ xin mach tꞌin̈ano yeco yin̈ isbeybal.
Tato ay hunu juẍtaj maca hunu janab yaꞌta yehi, yilal yakꞌni tzalaho yanma yin̈ Comam, yuto ay yelapno ye yul sat Comam Dios.
Hacpax tuꞌ ebnaj juẍta yeb ebix janab kꞌalom, tzalahojabi yet chiilaxayo yu Comam Dios, yuto haꞌ mac kꞌalom lahan hacaꞌ isxumaquil teꞌ telaj machi nahatli.

Yuto hayet chiꞌahilo tzꞌayic cat ispohcan̈ yip kꞌaꞌ, chitajilo teꞌ telaj, cat yay hona isxumaquil teꞌ, hac tuꞌ xin matxa cꞌulchꞌano jilni teꞌ. Hacaꞌ ishowayo isxumaquil teꞌ telaj tuꞌ, hac tuꞌ iscꞌayayo ebnaj kꞌalom yet chiscutxban ebnaj iskꞌalomal yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ.
Ilwebal yebej isyaꞌtajil

Sakꞌal yet mac chitecha ilwebal yu, yuto hayet chilahwi istecha ilwebal yu huneꞌ mac tuꞌ, chakꞌ Comam huneꞌ ispaj selel tet, haꞌ ton huneꞌ iskꞌinal mach istan̈bal, haꞌ ton huneꞌ corona haltebil yu Comam tet mac chitzala yin̈ Comam.

Hayet chon̈montelax cowatxꞌen hunu istxꞌojal, machojab chijala ta haꞌ Comam Dios chon̈monten cowatxꞌen huneꞌ tuꞌ, yuto Comam mach chu con̈ismonten cowatxꞌen hunu istxꞌojal, machipaxo tzet chimonten Comam yu yanico ismul.
Wal xin, haꞌ istxꞌojal ayco jin̈ haꞌ chon̈monteni, cat con̈yinito yin̈ istxꞌojal.
Ta chijaco janma yin̈ istxꞌojal ayticꞌaco jin̈, yin̈ chipitzcꞌati comul. Haxa yet chichꞌib huneꞌ istxꞌojal yul janma tuꞌ, cat yul huneꞌ camical jin̈.
Wuẍtaj wanab, hex caw xahan ay wuhan, mach cheyakꞌ subchaho heba.
Sunil tzet cꞌul yeb sunil tzet tzꞌajan yehi tet Comam Dios chicochah. Haꞌ Comam watxꞌen̈e sunil tzet chimujli yul satcan̈. Haꞌ huntekꞌan tuꞌ xin chishel isba, wal Comam Dios, huneꞌn̈eticꞌa haꞌ Comam.
Yuto el yin̈ iscꞌul Comam yakꞌni cokꞌinal mach istan̈bal yu Istzotiꞌ caw yeli, huneꞌ yakꞌ jet yet cochahni yul janma. Yu huneꞌ tuꞌ xin, han̈on̈ caw babelon̈ sata sunil tzet watxꞌebil yu Comam Dios.
Yilal coyijen tzet chal Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios
Wuẍtaj wanab, hex xahan ay wuhan, naweti huntekꞌan chiwaltiꞌan. Hajbawe hetxiquin heyabeni; mach comono cheyal hunu tzet ye tuꞌ yin̈ an̈e, mach comono chitit hehowal.
Yuto yet chitit cohowal, maẍtaj tzet choche Comam chicowatxꞌe.

Yuxin bejwecano sunil istxꞌojal yeb sunil ismachiswalilal caw chipoh yul yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ. Cꞌulchꞌanojab chu hechahni Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios challax teyet, huneꞌ tzꞌunbilxa yul heyanma yu Comam, yuto haꞌ chexcolni tet sunil istxꞌojal.
Machojab ton̈e chijabe Istzotiꞌ Comam, wal xin yilal coyijeni. Yaj tato ton̈e chijabe tzet chala, mach chicoyijepaxoj, han̈-caw-on̈ chijakꞌ subchaho coba.
Haꞌ mac chiꞌaben Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios, mach chiswatxꞌepaxo tzet chala, lahan hacaꞌ hunu mac chiyil sat yul chꞌen espejo,
yajaꞌ lahwi yilni sat tuꞌ, caw yin̈ an̈e chito nahul yu tzet yillax sat.
Wal mac mach chito nahul Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios yu, to caw chaco yin̈ iscꞌul yin̈ huneꞌ tzet chabe tuꞌ cat isyijeni, caw sakꞌal yet; haꞌ Istzotiꞌ Comam tuꞌ chon̈bejtzonilo yul iskꞌab ismachiswalilal.

Ta ay hunu mac yijem yin̈ tzet chal Comam Dios yalni, yaj ta mach chakꞌ cachaꞌ istiꞌ yin̈ istxꞌojal, haꞌ huneꞌ anma tuꞌ chiyakꞌ subchaho isba ischuquil. Hac tuꞌ xin naban̈e chala tato yijem yin̈ tzet chal Comam Dios.

Yaj ta chon̈colwa yin̈ niẍte unin mach ismam, mach ismiꞌ, yeb yin̈ ebix camnaxa yichamil, cat xin copohnilo coba yin̈ istxꞌojal yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, wal tuꞌ caw lan̈an coyijen tzet chal Comam Dios Mame.
